title: 第12章 第二案：水泥藏尸（5）
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李安国眸光微动，不由得坐直了些。

“那天高和美找我，是想帮她男朋友求情。

她男朋友之前是我的司机。

公车私用，在我需要出门的时候，开车送高和美的爸爸去医院。

导致我们公司项目竞标失败，净亏三千万。

所以公司决定辞退她男友。

高和美听说这件事后，不知道从哪知道我的电话号码，言辞恳切的请求与我见面。

我一时心软，就见了她。

但公是公，私是私。

我体谅他公车私用是救人心切，可公司亏损是客观事实。

每个人都应该为自己做的事负责。

所以我给了她一笔钱，作为失业空窗期的过渡。

自那以后，我就没有再见过她了。”

为了佐证自己说的都是事实。

王守财还特地掏出手机，调出通话记录。

署名高和美的电话已经被他拉黑，且最后一次通话，确实是前几天高和美约他见面那次。

日期和时间都对得上。

“你们约在哪见的面？”

“比邻咖啡厅，就在我们公司楼下。

我每天要处理的工作很多，临时计划都去不了太远的地方。”

李安国点头。

又询问了一些他和高和美见面时的细节。

王守财都一一回答。

非常配合。

聊了一会后，李安国突然问道：“你刚刚说和高和美见面的时候，她穿了一件什么颜色的裙子来着？”

“白色。”

“鞋子呢？”

“这……我还真有些记不清了，我也没在意。

可能也是白色吧？

当时是我去的时候，她已经在咖啡厅里等着了，我只注意到了她的衣服和长相，没看她穿什么鞋。”

人在撒谎的时候会刻意

真实记忆往往是比较模糊的。

所以王守财的话，有八分可信度。

不过对于王守财的嫌疑，李安国依旧保持观望态度。

“你说你知道高和美在哪？”

王守财点头，过了一秒，又摇头。

“准确来说不是我知道高和美在哪，而是我猜她和冯六在一起。

我和高和美见面第二天，是冯六约好来公司签解除协议的时间。

但冯六一直到现在都没来。

我以为冯六是想拖着这件事不解决，或者和我们公司打官司。

结果比冯六先来的，是高和美的爸爸。

我这才知道高和美失踪了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Li Anguo's eyes moved slightly and he couldn't help but sit up straighter.

"Gao Hemei came to me that day because she wanted to plead for her boyfriend.

Her boyfriend used to be my driver.

The bus is for private use. When I need to go out, I drive Gao Hemei's father to the hospital.

As a result, our company's project bidding failed, resulting in a net loss of 30 million.

So the company decided to fire her boyfriend.

After Gao Hemei heard about this, she didn't know where she got my phone number and sincerely requested to meet me.

I relented and met her.

But public is public and private is private.

I sympathize with his desire to save people by using his official car for personal use, but it is an objective fact that the company is losing money.

Everyone should be responsible for what they do.

So I gave her a sum of money to bridge the gap between unemployment.

I haven't seen her since."

To prove that what I said is true.

Wang Shoucai even took out his mobile phone and called up the call records.

The phone number signed by Gao Hemei has been blocked by him, and the last call was indeed the time Gao Hemei asked him to meet a few days ago.

The date and time are correct.

"Where did you meet?"

"Bilin Cafe is just downstairs from our company.

I have a lot of work to deal with every day, and even temporary plans can’t take me too far."

Li Anguo nodded.

He also asked some details about his meeting with Gao Hemei.

Wang Shoucai answered them all.

Very cooperative.

After chatting for a while, Li Anguo suddenly asked: "You just said that when you met Gao Hemei, what color skirt was she wearing?"

"White."

"Where are the shoes?"

"This...I really can't remember it clearly, and I don't care.

Maybe it’s white too?

When I went there, she was already waiting in the cafe. I only noticed her clothes and appearance, not what shoes she was wearing."

People are deliberate when they lie

Real memories are often vague.

Therefore, Wang Shoucai's words are 80% credible.

However, Li Anguo still maintains a wait-and-see attitude towards Wang Shoucai's suspicion.

"You said you know where Gao Hemei is?"

Wang Shoucai nodded, and after a second, shook his head again.

"To be precise, it's not that I know where Gao Hemei is, but I guess she is with Feng Liu.

The day after I met Gao Hemei, Feng Liu made an appointment to come to the company to sign the termination agreement.

But Feng Liu hasn't come until now.

I thought Feng Liu wanted to drag this matter out or start a lawsuit with our company.

It turned out that the person who came before Feng Liu was Gao Hemei's father.

Only then did I know that Gao Hemei was missing.
